recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec1iWGlvHcqZOP5v.Name: Barre Lando

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

recEDO3WWWhzVkwgI.Bio: Matt Presti is a metascientist, musician, and host of The Exploration of Consciousness (TEC) podcast, known for his long-running study of the science and philosophy of Walter Russell. His work centers on light, universal law, and cosmology, and on InnerVerse he has explored Russell's teachings alongside critiques of mainstream physics.
recEDO3WWWhzVkwgI.Name: Matt Presti

recnSUSIbX0lqTnAr.Bio: Mike Winner is a DJ and media producer known for his commentary on sovereignty, decentralization, and consciousness clarifying technology, closely associated with the Alfa Vedic community.
recnSUSIbX0lqTnAr.Name: Mike Winner
recnSUSIbX0lqTnAr.Role: DJ, media producer, and consciousness technology commentator

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Walter Russell and the Wave Universe", "body": "Matt Presti walked through Walter Russell's periodic chart, explaining that Russell placed the inert gases at the center of each octave and treated matter as waves rather than particles, with carbon as the balance point of the fourth octave. Mike Winner argued that the world needed Russell's cosmology to counter materialism. Dr. Barre Lando said the wave model let him reconcile what he had observed in plants, soil and bodies with a physics he could trust. A magnet demonstration clip from Matt was shown, and he presented it as a glimpse of the still white light."}, {"title": "Transmutation From Lab to Body", "body": "Mike Winner argued that human bodies transmute hydrogen into nitrogen every day, and Dr. Barre Lando offered salt turning into potassium as an example. Barre described using ionization analysis and a dual impedance antenna to read polarity in soil, plants and people. Matt Presti said Fulcanelli taught that alchemy aimed at transmuting the experimenter rather than metals, and that someone who unified their opposites could know an experiment's outcome through the divine mind. Barre also described linking different noble gas devices in his lab and comparing measurements."}, {"title": "Inert Gases as Light's Projector", "body": "Matt Presti likened the inert gases to the film in a projector, still points on the plane of the cube through which white light shone to form matter, and he tied them to the Akashic records. Barre Lando said he had spent decades with compressed noble gas devices and reported correlations between helium, neon, xenon and argon and different conditions, though he said he could not yet square this with wave mechanics. One of the hosts noted that noble gases also light neon signs and screens, and wondered whether that held a clue about technology and self image."}, {"title": "Dimensional Madness and Practical Spirituality", "body": "Matt Presti argued that anyone describing other dimensions, higher levels of consciousness or ascended masters does so from this world, so the work has to be done here, and he said the great work meant exploring your own dark crevices. Mike Winner urged younger listeners to treat Russell's science as a field for invention and enterprise, pointing to Alfa Vedic's own Russell branding. Dr. Barre Lando closed by calling \"I am\" the ultimate scientific statement and said a physician's real task was to teach and plant seeds."}, {"title": "Enneagram, Aliens and Alchemical Myth", "body": "Gabe (Slick Dissident) mapped the Enneagram onto works such as Plato's Symposium and noted that uranium, neptunium and plutonium lined up with the planetary correspondences of types three, six and nine. Matt Presti said Russell called the alien story the biggest hoax ever perpetrated on mankind, and Chance Garton said he saw a trail of receipts suggesting intelligence agencies seeded it as cover. Gabe later linked Fulcanelli hiding among the poor to the goddess Brigid and encouraged listeners to test philosophers one by one."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tonight we will explore enlightened esoteric physics with the return of Matt Presti, and Alfa Vedic's Mike Winner & Dr. Barre Lando. Bring your notepads for this one, as there are sure to be countless gems provided by this panel of prescient compadres!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "Really, everybody, it's you that does the work, no matter who brings it to you. You're the final arbiter in your own success story and your own application of the resources that you come across and how you employ them into your life.", "author": "Matt Presti", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7193971-6ddc-440f-a9e5-6078714e4d9b/matt-presti.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Our bodies literally do that every day, the hydrogen to nitrogen. We're transmuting that every day. And that gives an entirely new context to the idea of breatharianism or the Browns gas hydrogen machine, that if you're just getting hydrogen in your body, your body can turn that into anything.", "author": "Mike Winner", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e0d9730-f79f-4740-9294-454b580e6056/MIKE-WINNER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "One gentleman was speaking about his time living in India where they put salt on everything. And he just figured that was in order to maintain fluids in the tropical environment. But then later on he found out that salt, sodium, was actually transmuted into potassium, and potassium actually has a cooling effect on the body.", "author": "Dr. Barre Lando", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0ce86fbf-c9be-4c75-bbe6-0936f3766075/BARRE-LANDO.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The great thing about what we'll call nonconventional instrumentation is that you really have to attune yourself, so that you not only are getting quantitative information but also able to measure the qualitative side of things, which conventional science doesn't do. Of course, the qualitative side would begin with our creator, who has the original idea in the first place.", "author": "Dr. Barre Lando", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/0ce86fbf-c9be-4c75-bbe6-0936f3766075/BARRE-LANDO.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "What I would say to that, Mike, is that the mind is the only thing that can wrap around the whole. And literally, just on the tip of our perception is the gateway to the whole thing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "And why is there a black gap? His technique was to hide among the poor to where you could not tell him apart from them. And that's where he preferred to hang out. And he would often give secrets away to people that were considered inferior by royalty, and they actually hunted the guy.", "author": "Matt Presti", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7193971-6ddc-440f-a9e5-6078714e4d9b/matt-presti.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I think, again, with my Dispelling Dimensional Madness, the work and all the things we have to do can all be done here. It's the one we all share.", "author": "Matt Presti", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/b7193971-6ddc-440f-a9e5-6078714e4d9b/matt-presti.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "And then there's mountains of reason to believe that a lot of the alien stuff was engineered as some kind of experiment or seeding the thought into people's minds, intentionally by intelligence agencies.
